title: Chocolate, Hazelnut & Oat Oven-Baked Pancakes
description: An oats, hazelnut and yogurt batter studded with chocolate chips, baked on a tray until crisp outside and fluffy inside.
ingredients: To serve: fresh berries, maple syrup
steps: In a mini chopper, blend oats, hazelnuts, baking powder, egg, yogurt, vanilla and a pinch of salt until a textured batter forms.
Dollop onto a lined, sprayed baking tray as 4 pancakes. Spray tops.
Bake on top shelf for 10 minutes.
Flip with a spatula and bake another 5 minutes until golden and crisp outside, fluffy inside.
Serve with fresh berries and a small drizzle of maple syrup.
notes: Try adding ground cinnamon, orange zest, or swapping chocolate chips for blueberries.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
